description: Publication identity regression cases. Real pairs come from the corpus (PBDB reference numbers given); synthetic ones cover rules the corpus does not yet exercise.

doi.note: missing '10' prefix is flagged, not guessed

pairs.case: The Dinosauria 1st vs 2nd edition chapters share a title (pbdb-ref:7747, pbdb-ref:18136)
Same one-word chapter title by different authors in different books (pbdb-ref:36780, pbdb-ref:58211)
Same title, same year, different authors: title-only equality is never identity
Consecutive numbered parts of one series (pbdb-ref:4399, pbdb-ref:17322)

a.title: The Chañares (Argentina) Triassic reptile fauna; XIV, Lewisuchus admixtus, gen. et sp. nov.

b.title: The Chañares (Argentina) Triassic reptile fauna. XVI. Thecodont classification

pairs.case: PBDB entered one paper twice (online and print); equal DOI and title merge
A book DOI shared by different chapters is a conflict, not a merge
A corrigendum is related to its paper, never the same publication

a.title: Nanotyrannus and Tyrannosaurus coexisted at the close of the Cretaceous

b.title: Corrigendum: Nanotyrannus and Tyrannosaurus coexisted at the close of the Cretaceous

pairs.case: Preprint and final paper with different DOIs stay distinct records
No DOI, same title, year and first author: reported for review, not merged

a.title: Dwarf dinosaurs from the Late Cretaceous of Europe?

b.title: Dwarf dinosaurs from the Late Cretaceous of Europe
